topic: How miner upgrades change net yield
title: How Miner Upgrades Change Daily Net Yield
hook: Upgrading a digital miner changes more than one number.

scenes.narration: GoMining says daily BTC rewards are proportional to a miner's power and efficiency.
Fewer watts per terahash means less electricity for each unit of hashrate.
Maintenance is still deducted from rewards, so check your net result. It can be low or negative.

cta: What would you upgrade? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Upgrades change power and efficiency, but net yield still depends on fees and the market.

sources.title: GoMining docs: maintenance fees and discounts
